why: In every figure the arrow starts at or comes from the edge of the box and points into the box, so it moves inwards. In figures 1, 2, 3 and 5 the arrow goes from the border towards the middle. In figure 4 the arrow starts inside the box and its head goes out through the top border, so it points outwards. Figure 5 looks different because its tail is outside, but its head still points inwards. So figure 4 is the odd one out.
trick: Check where each arrow starts and where its head points (in or out of the box). Ignore the dashed lines, they are only distraction.
